integrity: An exact integral and combinatorial proof for all finite hosts, supplemented but not replaced by exhaustive finite-order tests; no independent mathematical audit performed.
limitations: Finite simple undirected hosts with iid atomless shared edge weights; regular triangle-free specialization for motif formula. Previously available general local-minimum identities could affect historical originality priority.
title: A four-cycle variance law for reciprocal nearest-neighbor edges in randomly weighted graphs
